name: Reusable Development Workflow Configuration
description: Single source of truth for branching, quality gates, testing, docs hygiene, and commit automation. Set projectType and customize the active 'commands' block. Scripts read this file to stay type-appropriate.
_projectTypeGuidance: The single most important field. Choose the closest match. Scripts (prepare-commit, hooks, etc.) read this and the matching profile to avoid running irrelevant tools (e.g. no eslint for pure Python). After choosing, copy the desired profile into the top-level 'commands' object and customize the strings for your exact tooling. Supported starters: node-fullstack, python, generic.

node-fullstack.checks: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npx tsc --noEmit && cd dashboard && npx tsc --noEmit
node-fullstack.unitTests: npm test && cd dashboard && npm test
node-fullstack.build: npm run build && cd dashboard && npm run build
node-fullstack.docDriftCheck: npm run verify:claude-md; npm run verify:schema || true
node-fullstack.notes: Full TypeScript SaaS (Next.js dashboard + Fastify/Node backend). ESLint + tsc + Vitest + Playwright are all relevant.

python.build: python -m py_compile $(find . -name '*.py' | head -20) 2>/dev/null || echo '(no build or use mypy/pyright)'
python.docDriftCheck: echo 'TODO: add your doc-drift or schema-drift command here (or leave empty string)'
python.e2e: echo 'No E2E configured (or: pytest --e2e or playwright for Python)'
python.notes: Python (FastAPI/Django/Flask/etc.). ruff + black + pytest. No npm, no tsc, no ESLint. Adapt as needed for your stack (mypy, pyright, etc.).

generic.checks: echo 'Define your project-specific checks command here (lint + typecheck equivalent)'
generic.unitTests: echo 'Define your test command (pytest, go test, cargo test, etc.)'
generic.build: echo 'Define your build command (or leave as no-op for interpreted languages)'
generic.lint: echo 'Define lint command (ruff, golangci-lint, etc.) or empty'
generic.formatCheck: echo 'Define format check (black --check, gofmt, etc.) or empty'
generic.docDriftCheck: echo 'Define doc/schema drift detector or leave empty'
generic.e2e: echo 'Define E2E command or leave empty'
generic.focusedTestScan: echo 'Define grep for focused/skip tests appropriate to your language, or empty'
generic.notes: Language-agnostic or mixed projects. Everything is a placeholder — replace the strings in the 'commands' block below.

commands._comment: ACTIVE commands for the current projectType. These are what the automation scripts actually execute. Populate by copying the matching block from projectTypeProfiles and editing the values for your exact binaries/paths.
commands.checks: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npx tsc --noEmit && cd dashboard && npx tsc --noEmit
commands.unitTests: npm test && cd dashboard && npm test
commands.build: npm run build && cd dashboard && npm run build
commands.docDriftCheck: npm run verify:claude-md; npm run verify:schema || true

notes: This config is the contract between humans and the automation scripts. Change projectType, copy the right profile into 'commands', customize the strings, and the prepare-commit / hook scripts will adapt. For non-Node projects you will also customize package.json scripts or replace the 'npm run' invocations with direct calls.
